temp.name: Global Temperature
temp.definition: The average temperature across Earth's surface, including land and oceans. A lasting rise means the whole planet is getting warmer, even though individual places still have cold days. This warming changes rainfall and makes many heat extremes more likely.

boundMetric.unit: degrees Celsius
boundMetric.geography: global with land-ocean coverage diagnostics

temp.reason: A global temperature anomaly describes climate state. An impact model must attribute health, service and ecological consequences; degrees are not harm units.
temp.metricFailureRule: Retain the latest annual reviewed value and mark stale when the source is unavailable; never infer missing months from the TULIP score.
